name: grid-subgrid-absolute-descendant-area
derivation: The relative-positioned subgrid covers parent columns2-3 and both rows. Parent columns17/29/47 with5px gaps put it at x22 with width29+5+47=81. Parent rows19/31 with7px gap give height57. Its absolute child's local lines2/3 in both axes establish a47x31 containing block at local(29+5,19+7)=(34,26). Zero insets fill that area. The child's source position is(34,26), while its world rectangle starts at(56,26); the absolute child contributes no track sizes.
